chunks: Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sukuni, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Indeed, the muwaddihah in the face and the head are equal.”

key_terms.الْمُوضِحَةَ: a wound that exposes the bone

ai.seo_question: Are the rulings for a muwaddihah wound in the face and the head the same in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal equivalence between a muwaddihah wound in the face and in the head. It is relevant to the rulings of diyaat and bodily injury compensation in Islamic jurisprudence.
